stemMd: A 5 kg object experiences a net horizontal force of 15 N. What is its horizontal acceleration?
explanationMd: Newton’s second law gives net force F = ma, so a = 15/5 = 3 m s⁻². The word net means all horizontal forces have already been combined. Weight does not replace the stated horizontal force in this calculation.

distractorRationale.c: This multiplies force and mass rather than dividing.
distractorRationale.b: This confuses a typical gravitational acceleration with the stated horizontal situation.
